The `cloud_stat` call was denied because the current token only has `service-log-level` scope. The observation provides an alternative way to get the size report: call `api_post /api/tickets/TCK-169746/size-report` and then poll the returned `status_path` using `api_get` until the status is "done".

1.  `api_post` to `/api/tickets/TCK-169746/size-report`.
2.  `api_get` the resulting `status_path` until status is "done".
3.  Submit the completion report.
